raw:
Agent Name: Filmography_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the initial compilation and filtering, the agent provided an incomplete and partially incorrect film list and misapplied the runtime filter. They omitted eligible Isabelle Adjani features under 2 hours (e.g., Barocco at 110 minutes per their own data, and The Story of Adele H., which is actually ~97–98 minutes), and failed to include other sub-120-minute titles like Nosferatu the Vampyre and Ishtar. This upstream error constrained the candidate set and led subsequent agents to evaluate the wrong subset, producing the incorrect final answer.
